prose: Sky News covers a report finding that nearly half of young people trust AI over a human for fact-checking - a striking data point on how information authority is shifting for the generation that grew up with chatbots. The full article could not be retrieved (the fetch returned an error), so the survey's sample and wording are unavailable; this summary is based on the headline.
